info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Operational Services Open Item Management By Open Item Management Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of operational services related to open items in a banking context. By utilizing a PATCH request, users can update specific details of an open item using its unique identifier. This functionality is essential for financial institutions looking to maintain accurate records and manage outstanding items efficiently. Typical consumers include banking operations teams and integration developers who need to ensure the accuracy and currency of banking data and processes.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific open item identified by its resource ID. It is typically used to modify attributes such as status, description, or any other relevant metadata associated with the open item.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the open item management service identified by RES-100045. It contains the details that need to be modified in the existing record.

200.description: The request was successful, and the item has been updated.
